description: Return the whole Polderchain Covenant text: Axiom Zero, the seven Directives each with its balance clause, and the rule for parking a deadlock to a human elder. Use it to read or quote the Covenant itself; to learn which Directives bear on a particular decision call deliberate instead, and to test one thought against the rules call ask_guidance. Open to everyone with no key; the document is identical for every caller (about 20 KB as JSON), so fetch it once per session and keep it. Nothing you send is stored.

as_markdown.description: false (default): structured JSON objects per Directive; true: the same text as one Markdown document, for quoting or display

name: get_covenant

outputSchema.description: the Covenant as JSON (default) or as {markdown} when as_markdown=true

manifests_as.description: how it shows up in practice

balance.description: the balance clause that stops it being absolute

markdown.description: present only when as_markdown=true: the whole Covenant as one Markdown document

title: Read the Covenant
